column1: # Common English misspellings -> correction. Authored for KeyLingo.
# Used for cases edit distance cannot decide: split words ("alot" -> "a lot"),
# ties between real words ("wich": which/with/wish), and misspellings of rare
# real words ("wether"). Applied as an autocorrection only when the typed word
# is not in the user's learned vocabulary and not rejected this session.
